title: Root of Corruption
description: The blight spreading out of Willow Dale Ruins has already taken one plot of land bare - a smallholding on the ruins' edge whose family salted what soil they could save and moved into Dalhurst with nothing. Priestess Elara does not want a second family to lose their ground the same way. As a Devotee of Gaela, you are sent to find what is maintaining the corruption and put a stop to it before it reaches the next farm.

objectives.description: Investigate the source of the blight in Willow Dale Ruins
Find the corrupted artifact causing the blight
Defeat the cultists keeping the corruption fed
Return the corrupted artifact to Priestess Elara for cleansing

notes: Threat: one family already lost their land to this blight and left; the quest exists to stop a second one losing theirs. Giver motive: Elara has already failed one household once and does not intend to fail a second. Consequence: not wired; the abandoned smallholding is prose only. Known duplicate of the root file gaela_blight, deliberately differentiated - this copy is the temple's own investigation with a devotee doing the work; the root copy is the same blight reaching Millbrook and told from a townsman's report of it.
